paragraphs: Apple made some big promises for AirPods 5, particularly when it comes to active noise cancellation. After spending time with the new earbuds, I can say the company wasn’t exaggerating. ANC is dramatically better than it was on previous open-ear AirPods, making AirPods 5 much more useful in noisy environments. Which is great, because Apple put ANC in its most affordable AirPods, too.

And that’s not the only upgrade that makes a difference. Apple also added something I’ve wanted on my AirPods for years: volume controls right on the stems. That’s reserved for the slightly pricier AirPods 5 variant, though.
I’m a long-time AirPods user, and I could argue that there are enough improvements in AirPods 5 that you might want to replace your AirPods 4. Here’s why.

While I love iPhone, iPad and other Apple computers, I do not think that all the best accessories come out of Cupertino. Apple’s chargers are adequate and its cables are definitely subpar, while the official iPhone cases are … meh. I hope that gives you some perspective when I say that AirPods are absolutely the best wireless earbuds for Apple users. They fit into the Apple ecosystem in a way competing earbuds simply can’t match.

Pairing is effortless, but seamlessly switching between an iPhone, iPad and Mac is actually my favorite feature. AirPods automatically connect to whichever device I’m using at the time. It’s a dramatically different experience from when I used wireless headphones from another company and had to manually switch them from one computer to another.

Plus, advanced features like Active Noise Cancellation, Find My, personalized audio and Siri are built right in. And to be clear, these are all features of the base model AirPods 5. Sure, you can get additional features with AirPods Pro … if you pay a lot more. But why? The $129 version offers so much.
AirPods 5 offer improved Active Noise Cancellation to help reduce outside noise, at their best value yet. Also added to the base version of these wireless earbuds is Live Translation.
They boast a next-generation Adaptive EQ for better sound quality, personalized Spatial Audio and an open-ear design.
